selection_rule.checkpoint_per_candidate: best.pt selected by the candidate's total validation objective
hard_constraints: strict horizontal HRIR ILD MAE must improve relative to initial v3
validation residual MAE may not regress by more than 0.5 percent
validation ERB proxy may not regress by more than 0.5 percent
validation contralateral high-frequency MAE may not regress by more than 0.5 percent
ranking: largest relative strict horizontal HRIR ILD improvement
largest minimum relative improvement across residual, ERB, and high-frequency metrics

selection_result: All candidates passed the hard constraints; weight 2.0 produced the largest strict horizontal HRIR ILD improvement.
test_policy: The locked test split must not be exported or read.
